note: SC-200 voice-over, one beat a line; gap = silence after it (s). Figures are the 12 Oct production runs' own (REPORT.md of 2026-10-12-prod-mango and -prod-sad). Numbers are written out as spoken. 'say' carries Kokoro's inline phonemes where a name is misread (Rakesh, Priya).

lines.text: Every day in India, good food runs out of time.
Not because it has spoiled, but because it is short-dated.
Once a batch slips past the quick-commerce cut-off, nobody will take it.
So it is written off, its tax credit is reversed, and perfectly good food ends up in a landfill.
Smart-Clearance gives every one of those cartons a second chance.
It is software as a service for manufacturers. Every brand gets its own workspace, where ten AI agents, built on Gemini, walk each short-dated batch to the exits that recover the most.
And a person says yes, just once.
It all begins in the console, where the Smart-Clearance team runs the platform.
One overview shows every client at a glance: what has been recovered, what is in flight, and what is waiting for a yes.
Each client's agents are tuned to its own supply chain: the Watcher's quick-commerce gates, how far the Negotiator may bargain, and the one approval that is never switched off.
Now, two batches from Munchly Foods, live in production.
First, the Mango Drink at Lakshmi Agencies in Hyderabad. The Watcher flags it: twenty-two days left, and over twenty-two thousand rupees about to be written off.
Vision reads the carton's label from a single photo, and matches it to the stock export.
The Valuer prices every exit, the Router splits the batch, and Priya, in supply chain, approves the plan with one yes.
lines.say: The Valuer prices every exit, the Router splits the batch, and [Priya](/pɹˈijə/), in supply chain, approves the plan with one yes.

lines.text: Fifty-two kiranas take the scheme. Every order lands live on her screen, each with its own tax invoice.
The staff sale is checked against its U P I receipt, and Feeding India collects fifty-eight packs, with a donation receipt of its own.
Paperwork signs every paper, Impact posts the ledger, and Lakshmi Agencies ends whole. Nearly seventeen thousand rupees recovered, and nothing left to waste.
But not every batch goes to plan.
The Masala Chips at Rakesh Traders in Nagpur are offered to thirty-eight kiranas. Just two of them buy.
lines.say: The Masala Chips at [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) Traders in Nagpur are offered to thirty-eight kiranas. Just two of them buy.

lines.text: On Expire Soon, a wholesaler bids thirteen rupees a pack. The Negotiator counters at fourteen rupees twenty, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs are sold.
Still, when the window closes, five hundred and forty packets are left at the godown.
On expiry day, nothing is hidden. Rakesh sends two photos, before and after, and Vision checks the label, the count, the slate and the landfill.
lines.say: On expiry day, nothing is hidden. [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) sends two photos, before and after, and Vision checks the label, the count, the slate and the landfill.

lines.text: The agency's officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate in place, right on his screen.
lines.say: The agency's officer, two witnesses and [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) sign the certificate in place, right on his screen.

lines.text: Only after Priya's second yes is the credit note issued. Even now, nearly twelve thousand rupees are recovered, the distributor ends whole, and every kilo is on the record.
lines.say: Only after [Priya's](/pɹˈijəz/) second yes is the credit note issued. Even now, nearly twelve thousand rupees are recovered, the distributor ends whole, and every kilo is on the record.

lines.text: The brand recovers. The distributor ends whole. Kiranas earn, food banks receive, and less food goes to waste.
Smart-Clearance. Every near-expiry carton, a second chance.
